title: Specification of circuit sealing
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with input indices $0,\ldots,n-1$, a valid output vertex, and gates whose arguments are distinct and have the prescribed count: one for a NOT gate and two otherwise. Seal every vertex index below the circuit size that is not the output and has fanout zero, starting from the gates and output of $C$. The resulting gates extend the original list by gates with distinct arguments and the prescribed argument counts, remain acyclic, and have a valid output whose value agrees with the original circuit's output on every Boolean input.
